products.title: Calvin Pull-On Chino in Wine
products.body_html:
The Calvin Chino is ready to change the way you think about – and wear – a classic. Born from our ongoing pursuit to deliver style for every mood and every moment, the Calvin is our answer to a pant that does it all without asking you to compromise.

Finished with a natural, washed aesthetic that offers a lived-in feel, the Calvin is engineered with our proprietary ComfortChino fabric, skipping the athletic shine found in some of our other pull-on styles, while staying true to its refined-yet-relaxed roots. Offered in five distinct colorways that honor both timeless and modern palettes, it is court, course and club approved.

products.title: Redvanly x Bridgestone Golf Balls
products.body_html:
The REDVANLY x Bridgestone Golf limited-edition TOUR B RX golf balls feature the REDVANLY and Bridgestone Golf logos on the ball and come in custom REDVANLY packaging.

The limited-edition Bridgestone TOUR B RX golf ball features impressive technologies including the new REACTIV X System with REACTIV iQ Smart Cover Technology and XCLRNT mid-layer for increased distance and control. The Bridgestone TOUR B RX golf ball is played in professional competition by Tour staffer Fred Couples and is recommended for players with swing speeds under 105 mph.
